action.text: Task: Fix singledispatch so that union registration containing an ABC properly tracks the abc cache_token, so later virtual-subclass registrations invalidate the dispatch cache. Current state: full Lib/functools.py visible (1000 lines). Identified bug: in register(), `hasattr(cls, '__abstractmethods__')` is False for union types, so cache_token stays None, and dispatch never checks abc token changes. Fix: when registering a union, check member types for __abstractmethods__. Need: tests/test_virtual_registration.py contents, Doc/howto/ contents.
